added_comments.text: Two calls so the request goes through both edge nodes.

rationale: The agent replaced the manual '&'.join query-string construction with urllib's urlencode/quote, properly percent-encoding special characters (spaces, ampersands) for all callers of _build_url, fixing the underlying encoding defect rather than special-casing /v2/exports in the FLAKY_ENDPOINTS workaround; it did not touch list_reports' naive Bogota-time behavior.
